changelog:
Initial release: Quickly check Alibaba Cloud security product coverage for specific vulnerabilities (CVE/AVD) using an offline data snapshot.

- Supports queries for Security Center (SAS), WAF, Cloud Firewall (CFW), and RASP coverage on 1697 high-risk vulnerabilities (2002–2026).
- Purely offline: uses Bash and grep on a local data file, requires no credentials or network access.
- Detects Chinese/English product names and answers in Chinese with official AVD references.
- Automatically handles product in/out of scope, file availability checks, and bulk CVE lookups.
- Prevents leakage or live data fetching; responds exclusively based on the included snapshot.
